claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.42 Genetics and Society ZIP audit regraded at 97/A and showed 50 atom sourceRefs covered through one CourseIR row while nine trusted source rows were exported beside it.
proofCommands: Manual EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit summarized in docs/V0.15.43_TRUSTED_SOURCEREF_BRIDGE_ROADMAP.md from verification-output/edutool-audit-loop/20260621T010414Z/

claims.summary: Package export bridges complete CourseIR sourceRef coverage to trusted concept-linked source ledger rows when the old CourseIR row is only review fallback proof.
The manifest discloses courseIR.sourceRefBridge with trusted row count, concept-linked row count, and replaced review-row count.
The patch does not invent licenses, change source scoring, weaken ambiguous-license findings, or lower the source-ledger grader.
